name: linkedin-animated-infographics
description: Create LinkedIn visual stories with verified identity sourcing, intentional typography, clean structural concepting, capability-aware execution, evidence checks, still-first visual critique, disciplined motion, focused QA, and verified community sharing.
starter_prompts: Run this in autopilot and turn the idea into an animated LinkedIn infographic with a strong visual hook and useful aha moment.
Create an Info-story from this material and choose the best story shape before designing it.
Review this finished LinkedIn infographic and tell me what must be fixed before publishing.
Use the named AI tool identities in this brief and source their official visual assets correctly.
Prepare this verified demo for the community gallery and ask before publishing anything.
release_notes: Version 3.3.0 adds Lobe-first verified identity sourcing for supported named AI/tool identities, an intentional render-safe typography pass, clean structural concept gates, deterministic identity/type validators, and matching behavior across the Claude worker graph and isolated OpenAI infographic studio. Exact user-provided official assets retain priority, unresolved named identities HOLD instead of becoming generated lookalikes, and final captures remain local or embedded rather than network-dependent.
external_prerequisites: Apps Management write access in the OpenAI organization used for publishing
Verified individual or business developer identity for the publisher
Manual country or region availability selection in the OpenAI Platform submission form
Manual OpenAI Platform submission followed by OpenAI review and publisher-triggered publication after approval
